feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing rollback and deployment-marker features with affected files, components, and test IDs.

frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and applying global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry page loading the React app root and main TypeScript bundle.

frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup with routes for landing, calculator, invoices, upgrade, and payment pages wrapped in ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with error handling and react‑query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Manages invoice detail inputs, VAT logic, line items, and validation before moving to the next invoice creation step.

frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation tabs, branding, login button, and event logging.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only form to configure Stripe keys via backend with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Renders a checkout button that creates a Stripe session, logs the event, and redirects to the checkout URL. Handles processing state and error toasts.

frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Upgrade modal presenting Starter and Pro plan options with event logging and navigation to the upgrade page.

frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Shows VAT details for a selected country, including rates, features, and a button to proceed if configuration exists.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: EU VAT intro screen allowing users to select a country and continue to the VAT calculator.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Displays detailed and simplified VAT explanations with an optional Pro-only PDF export and UK/EU-specific logic.
Displays a dialog explaining VAT paywall and logs an event when opened, offering navigation to upgrade.
Renders a horizontal step indicator showing progress through a multi-step VAT flow.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Shows a global alert warning that VAT calculations are estimates and not legal advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates reverse charge eligibility for B2B VAT IDs and displays validation checks and result.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects transaction details for VAT calculation, including customer type, VAT ID, rate, and reverse charge options.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkSelectC: Intro step for UK VAT calculator showing UK VAT rates and a continue button.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkTransac: Form for entering UK transaction details with misuse warnings and support for multiple supply types.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays VAT calculation results with scenario-specific alerts such as reverse charge or zero-rated export.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates deployment slugs against format rules.

frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks and increments anonymous daily usage using a fingerprint with a free usage limit.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session via the backend and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Computes a daily fingerprint and country from IP for analytics and rate‑limits.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Logs analytics events to the backend using fingerprint and country data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and provides identity through context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceNumberUniqu: Checks whether an invoice number already exists via the backend.
Provides hooks for listing invoices and downloading invoices or exports through the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Handles invoice saving with plan quota checks and invalidates plan and invoice queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Determines plan access flags (free, starter, pro) from account plan data.
Derives and exposes the user's preferred language from the browser.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches caller user profile and Stripe configuration status from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base config defining light/dark theme variables and utility component styles.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Defines the set of core analytics event names.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Fetches country and IP using ipapi.co for lightweight geolocation.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends event records to the backend with device and page metadata.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Computes a daily, hashed browser fingerprint using IP, user agent, and date with session caching. Provides functions to generate, cache, and clear the fingerprint.

frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceVatCateg: Generates VAT category notes and scenario‑specific warnings for invoices. Aggregates required notes from item categories and VAT scenarios.

Checks required invoice fields based on VAT scenario and returns which fields are missing or incomplete.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production‑only build marker and exposes the marker string for testing.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Implements deterministic German‑to‑English word translation with a fixed dictionary and a heuristic for detecting German text.

frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT calculation input/output types and computes EU VAT, including reverse charge, exemptions, and rate selection logic.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Contains EU country VAT rate configurations and helpers for retrieving country data.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainUkVat.ts: Generates explanatory text for UK VAT scenarios based on the calculated VAT result.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed explanations for German VAT scenarios based on calculation inputs and results.
Provides simplified, kid-friendly explanations of VAT scenarios using the same inputs and results.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores historical German VAT rates and offers helpers to retrieve rates for specific dates and compare them to current rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re-exports all VAT-related modules for easier importing.
frontend/src/lib/vat/isZeroVatResult.ts: Determines whether a VAT calculation result represents an explicit 0% VAT scenario.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks if a transaction qualifies for EU OSS registration based on service type and customer details.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines system prompts and step-by-step flow instructions for the German VAT calculation engine.
frontend/src/lib/vat/region.ts: Provides region detection, normalization, and support checks for multi-region VAT logic.
frontend/src/lib/vat/selectedSellerCount: Parses and validates the seller country from URL parameters with fallback and error handling.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukMisuseWarnings.ts: Detects common UK VAT misuse patterns and returns warnings when categories don't match service types.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukTypes.ts: Defines UK VAT-related types, categories, scenarios, and result structures.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates VAT IDs for reverse-charge eligibility and returns structured validation results.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Computes VAT rates per country and category using lookup tables and country-specific reduced rate rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatTable.ts: Defines VAT rates, currency info, and lookup helpers for countries with legacy name support and aliases.

frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders landing page with region selector and navigation to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with navigation options.
